title: The Sealed Letter
_designNote: allowUnderflow=true documents an outstanding authoring gap: the 'bribe-scribe' choice removes gold x25 but startState seeds none. Either add a prior reward chain or move the gold cost onto startState. Until then, allowUnderflow keeps CI green while preserving the warning as a marker.
description: Kesh of Reed-End intercepts the player on the Gravenmarsh Causeway with a sealed letter for Commander Solan Drest, bypassing Lieutenant Varn. The chain ends when Brother Velm translates an Ardweld funerary glyph recovered from the Lost Expedition.

beats.description: On the Gravenmarsh Causeway, Kesh of Reed-End presses a sealed letter and a silver signet into the player's hand. 'Drest. Eyes only. Not Varn. Especially not Varn.'

choices.text: Take the letter and swear by the signet.

beats.description: At Gravenhold's outer gate, Lieutenant Varn intercepts. 'The Commander's schedule is tight. I'll take that.' His hand is already out.
A day later: Kesh is found face-down in the bog. 'Exposure,' the bogmen say. Drest summons the player. Calm. Asks what was in the letter the player never delivered.

choices.text: Confess. Varn took it. You didn't know.
Lie. Drest catches it (his intent-read assumed).

beats.description: Varn does not forget. To reach Drest unaccompanied, the player must pick a method.

choices.text: Take the servants' stair (Thornwood-sympathetic scullery mage).
Invoke the Rider's once-per-arc commission privilege.

beats.description: In Drest's private chamber the seal cracks. Drest reads. He goes very still. 'Orla saw a glyph. On a skeleton that should not have had bones.' He needs Brother Velm of Eastmile — fast.
Drest nods once. 'You will be of use.' Varn is now a marked problem. Chain ends with Varn-treachery seed planted.
Drest's eyes do not change. 'Go.' The Gravenguard file on the player is now permanent. Remnant chain access sealed.
East road. Varn (if flagged) has already dispatched two assumed-deniable footmen to a forest choke-point. Velm is at the chapel; which of him survives depends on the player.

choices.text: Ride fast, fight the ambush, reach Velm inside three days.
Detour via the Holt (safe but slow — five+ days).
Take the ambush badly. Velm not retrieved.

beats.description: Velm reads the glyph at Gravenhold. He breaks down. 'This is a naming. A *funerary* naming. Something in that expedition was already dead, and someone had already un-killed it.' Drest promotes the player's access.
Velm reads the glyph, but his reading is subtly wrong. He says it's a ward-sign, not a naming. An Ashen Dream-Walker reached him during the detour. The player may or may not notice.

choices.text: Notice the lie (high Perception / Thornwood Trusted).
Accept Velm's reading at face value.

beats.description: Kesh mutters half a sentence and walks back into the reeds. The letter finds another hand. The chain does not unlock for this player.
The Ardweld Remnant precursor is live. Drest trusts the player with the Lost Expedition's real worth. Player reputation with Gravenguard pushed toward Trusted.
Player knows Velm is compromised. Drest seals the matter quietly; Velm is placed under protective watch. Remnant precursor unlocked at +300 instead of +500.
Drest acts on the false reading. Ashen Court has planted a lie in Gravenguard's most trusted catalogue. Remnant chain proceeds on rotted foundations. Mid-chain Ashen reveal later.
Velm is killed in the ambush. Drest seals the matter. No rep loss, but Remnant access gated behind a later, harder alternate entry.
